tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: residence_processing_latest
tools.description: How many days did ISA take on average, in its latest published period, to process a residence application for this status of residence? Give status (key, Japanese or English name), optionally procedure. Returns figures with period, blank cells, the PDF's notes, ISA's PDF URL and retrieval time. Stat

tools.name: residence_processing_history
tools.description: How has ISA's average processing time for this status of residence changed over time? Give status and optionally procedure and measure. Returns series per granularity (monthly from October 2024, quarterly FY2017 to FY2024 Q2, never mixed or interpolated), procedure and measure, oldest first, with pe

tools.name: residence_processing_statuses
tools.description: Which statuses of residence and procedures do ISA's processing-time tables cover, and which keys and names does this service accept? Returns the canonical list (key, Japanese and English names), procedures and measures.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
